This one is clickable.
In "02–05 · The app": press Upload Resume, then Tailor My Resume — the progress runs and drops you in the editor. Click any tailored line to edit it. The sidebar switches screens, pipeline stages filter the table, and a table row opens the application drawer.

Sample data throughout: the 127,483 counter, the 24 applications and the 82% match are plausible placeholders, not real numbers. Aisha Khan and her resume are invented. The privacy section carries a bracketed placeholder for your real policy link.
